name: Regression Testing Integration
description: Add lightweight regression testing to FADE workflow. Tests are generated from completed PRD acceptance criteria (with full repo context), run on STORY_DONE for fast feedback, and failures block iteration. Developer controls test scope by simply managing files in fade/tests/. CI/CD handles comprehensive testing; this is for fast local feedback during development.

userStories.title: Scaffold tests folder on fade init
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade init to create the tests folder structure so I'm ready to accumulate regression tests
acceptanceCriteria: fade init creates fade/tests/ directory
fade init creates fade/tests/run.sh with executable permissions
run.sh is a scaffold that loops through fade/tests/PRD-*/ folders
run.sh exits 0 if all tests pass
run.sh writes failures to fade/tests/failed.log and exits non-zero on any failure
Empty tests folder (no PRD-* subfolders) results in pass (exit 0)

userStories.title: Generate tests on PRD completion
userStories.description: As a developer, I want regression tests automatically generated when a PRD completes so my acceptance criteria become executable tests
acceptanceCriteria: On ALL_COMPLETE signal, agent is prompted to generate tests
Agent has full repo context (code, FADE.md, existing tests) when generating
Tests are written to fade/tests/{PRD-ID}/ folder
Each testable AC gets its own test file named test_{US-ID}_{AC-num}_{slug}.sh
Tests are shell/curl by default (no external dependencies)
Agent skips ACs that are not testable (e.g., architectural, subjective) with a comment in the test folder
Generated tests include clear assertions and expected values

userStories.title: Run tests on STORY_DONE
userStories.description: As a developer, I want regression tests to run after each story completion so I get fast feedback on whether I broke anything
acceptanceCriteria: After STORY_DONE signal detected, fade executes fade/tests/run.sh
Test execution only happens if fade/tests/run.sh exists and is executable
Test output is displayed to developer
Tests pass: iteration continues normally
Tests fail: iteration blocks with message pointing to fade/tests/failed.log
Test run respects 5-minute budget - if tests exceed this, developer should curate

userStories.title: Failed log captures actionable details
userStories.description: As a developer, I want clear failure information so I can quickly identify what broke
acceptanceCriteria: fade/tests/failed.log is overwritten on each test run (not appended)
Log includes timestamp of test run
Log includes which test file failed
Log includes expected vs actual values where available
Log includes endpoint/command that failed
Log format is grep-friendly (one failure per block, clear delimiters)

userStories.title: Developer can clear tests for context switch
userStories.description: As a developer, I want simple control over which tests run so I can focus on my current work area
acceptanceCriteria: Deleting fade/tests/PRD-*/ folders removes those tests from the run
Empty fade/tests/ folder (just run.sh) results in pass (no tests to run)
No archive mechanism needed - delete what you don't want
Documentation explains the 'delete to focus' pattern

userStories.title: Update prompt.md with test generation instructions
userStories.description: As a developer using FADE, I want the prompt template to include test generation guidance so Claude knows how to create good tests
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md template includes test generation section
Instructions specify shell/curl as default format
Instructions specify test file naming convention
Instructions specify to use repo context for concrete assertions
Instructions specify to skip untestable ACs with explanation
Instructions reference the testing.md standard for test quality
